ValidationRule.description: R-RC6: a per gift receipt names one gift; a consolidated statement names none, its gifts are its lines. A receipt reconciled from a consumed number names no gift, so only issued receipts are checked (R-RC3).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Status__c) = "Issued", OR( AND( TEXT(Type__c) = "Per gift", ISBLANK(Gift__c) ), AND( TEXT(Type__c) = "Consolidated statement", NOT(ISBLANK(Gift__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A per gift receipt must name its gift, and a year end statement must not name one.
